339: How soon will I receive a profile? ▾
340: The timeframe depends on the need, the city and available profiles. Write to us on WhatsApp to explain your request, and we will outline the options.
341: What happens if I am not satisfied? ▾
342: If a replacement is needed, the Sérénité and Premium packages provide for this possibility for 2 and 6 months respectively, subject to their terms. Ask for the applicable details before confirming the introduction.
343: How are the placement fees paid? ▾
344: The placement fees are paid only after the profile is approved and the placement is made. You pay nothing before you have found your candidate. The monthly salary is paid directly to the employee, separately from the placement fees.
346: No. The referral fee covers the search, selection and presentation of profiles: it is non-refundable, including where the proposed profile does not suit you.
347: That said, you are not on your own: tell us in writing (WhatsApp or email) and you benefit from a replacement period of 7 to 15 days to receive a suitable profile, with no additional referral fee.
348: The Sérénité and Premium packages provide longer replacement periods (2 and 6 months), subject to their terms. Details are set out in the legal notice.
349: What is the difference between live-in and live-out? ▾
350:
Live-in: the employee stays in the home under the agreed conditions. Working hours and rest days are agreed with the family.

Live-out: hours and arrangements are set according to the role and the agreement with the family.
351: Requirements for hosting a live-in domestic helper
352: Three meals a day of adequate quantity and quality, plus unlimited access to safe drinking water
353: A decent room for her sole use, with privacy
354: Daily rest time must be respected
355: Fair conditions for all three parties: the family, the helper and Yallah Services
356: If these conditions are not met, Yallah Services may withdraw the helper
357: How does a worker organise cooking, cleaning and childcare?
359: Cooking and cleaning are scheduled around naps and times when the child plays independently
360: Duties are agreed in advance with the family

362: Which cities do you cover? ▾
363: Our main search areas are Casablanca, Bouskoura, Dar Bouazza, Bouznika, Rabat, Marrakech, Tangier, Agadir, Fez, Kenitra, Mohammedia, Temara and Sale. Availability for a specific job and neighbourhood must be confirmed. Day cleaning is offered only in Casablanca and Rabat.
364: Are staff background-checked and trained? ▾
365: We do not claim to conduct background checks or provide certified training. Information shared varies by profile; ask for it and check documents and skills before making a decision.
366: What is the employee's monthly salary? ▾
367: The salary depends on the service and the tasks entrusted. Our official price list (monthly salary paid to the employee):
368: • Cleaning: villa 4,500 MAD · mini villa 4,000 MAD · apartment 3,500 MAD
369: • Nanny: 1 child 3,500 MAD (+ cleaning 4,000 MAD) · 2 children with cleaning 4,500/5,000 MAD · 3 children 4,500 MAD (+ cleaning 5,000 MAD)
370: • Cooking: simple cooking 4,000 MAD · cooking/cleaning 5,000 MAD · kitchen help 3,500 MAD · kitchen help/cleaning 4,000 MAD
372: • Live-out (Casa & Rabat): cleaning 600 MAD/week · cleaning + cooking 800 MAD/week · cleaning + nanny 800 MAD/week
373: • One-off day service (Casa & Rabat): standard cleaning 300/400 MAD · deep cleaning 500/700 MAD
374: These rates are indicative and may vary with the conditions and responsibilities. Placement fees (500 or 1,000 MAD) are added to these salaries. The salary is paid directly to the employee by the household.
375: How does the first meeting with the employee work? ▾
376: You can speak with the person and check relevant information before deciding. If you want another profile, the replacement terms of your chosen package apply.

378: Languages vary by profile. Tell us which languages you need and ask what information is available about the relevant person before the introduction.
379: What happens if the employee falls ill or leaves? ▾
380: Packages set out replacement terms for a defined period. Ask about the terms for your chosen package before the introduction.
